title: Test vectors: IPv6-in-IPv6 tunnel (inner HL decrement, decap, inner-dst verify)
description: Child of b7z9.4. test/vectors/ srh_root_insertion.json / srh_admission.json / source_route_hop_limit.json cover RH3 insertion/admission only. Add vectors for: root encapsulation inner HL decrement (orig HL, num_addrs, expected inner HL, plus rejection case SL >= available HL), E-side decap (valid outer+RH3+inner -> inner packet, inner-dst mismatch -> reject, malformed inner -> reject). Cross-implementation: Rust and C decap must accept identical vectors. Files: test/vectors/ + generator entries in test/vectors/generate.py if applicable.
close_reason: Delivered on fix-dio-unicast-dis-0l4q commit 27aa680f6a (heft worktree on origin/main lineage; co-located with 0l4q's DIO-fix branch — commits are cleanly separated by message for the janitor). Deliverables: (1) test/vectors/generate_tunnel_encapsulation.py — INDEPENDENT-oracle generator (reimplements spec 05-routing 8.9 arithmetic from the spec text; no lichen imports; RFC 8200 checksum included); (2) test/vectors/tunnel_encapsulation.json — 10 vectors: 5 encapsulation (inner HL = orig-1-num_addrs for 64/2-hop, 1-hop, min-HL-ok configs + 2 hop-budget rejections SL>=HL-after-fwd) and 5 decapsulation (valid post-SRH-consumption outer -> inner; inner-dst mismatch; inconsistent inner payload-length; wrong outer nh; truncated inner). (3) lichen-node unit test tunnel_encapsulation_vectors_decap_conformance consumes all decap vectors against decapsulate_ipv6 — PASSES. Key modeling decision documented: decap vectors use the POST-SRH-consumption packet form (nh=41, SRH stripped) because that is the packet decapsulate_ipv6 operates on at the final hop; the encap vectors carry the full SRH form for the root side and are ready for C consumption when b7z9.4.3 implements the C encapsulation/decap. Full rpl_stack suite: 31 passed +1 pre-existing failure (three_rpl_stacks, worker-6's 0l4q migration — unrelated to vectors).
